explanation: For each starting cell, recursively match the pattern’s suffix through four-neighbor moves. Cache failed (row,column,offset) states within that start. Cells are not marked visited because this EPI contract permits reuse.
timeComplexity: O((RC)^2 L) expected upper bound for R rows, C columns and length L: each start has its own failed-state cache.
spaceComplexity: O(RCL) failed-state space and O(L) recursion depth for one start.
